system.description:
This Homebrew Content has been Tested per the Untested guidelines. Whether or not it can be used is, as always, the prerogative of the Gamemaster.

Homebrew Reference Book: Legacy of the Force Sourcebook

See also: Feats

You prefer to let your muscles do the talking.

Prerequisite: Strength 13

Effect: Once per encounter, when you fail a Persuasion check to Intimidate, you can immediately reroll the check, adding your Strength modifier to the second result. However, the result of the reroll must be accepted, even if it is worse.
